title: backlog.py check calls a repro's kb-root-relative article path gone, as in BG-s5cpo5ml's factdiff filter
goal: backlog.py check reads a path inside a repro or check that is relative to a kb root (agents/doc-lookup-sources.md, as factdiff.py prints it) as that root's article, not as a repository path, and warns of it as gone only when no root holds it; seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where the worker-filed BG-s5cpo5ml got 'its repro names agents/doc-lookup-sources.md, which is gone' though the public root holds that article

run: import subprocess,sys;o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','check'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;n=[l for l in o.splitlines() if 'BG-s5cpo5ml' in l and 'which is gone' in l];print(len(n));sys.exit(1 if n else 0)
